{"id":"browser.reparent","input":{"$defs":{"IdOrName":{"description":"A feature's id (a number) or its name.","type":["number","string"]},"PlacementRef":{"anyOf":[{"format":"uint64","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},{"items":{"format":"uint64","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"type":"array"}],"description":"A placement: an occurrence id, or its path of occurrence ids from the top of the design."}},"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","additionalProperties":false,"description":"Move placements, timeline features and bodies into a component in one undo step, all or

Anything already in the component is left alone.","properties":{"bodies":{"default":null,"description":"The bodies to move, by name.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":["array","null"]},"component":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/IdOrName"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"The component they go to, by id or name. Default: the active component."},"component_path":{"default":null,"description":"The placement of that component to place them by, as occurrence ids from the top.","items":{"format":"uint64","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"type":["array","null"]},"features":{"description":"The features to move, by id or name.","items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/IdOrName"},"type":["array","null"]},"occurrences":{"description":"The placements to move.","items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/PlacementRef"},"type":["array","null"]}},"title":"ReparentItemsParams","type":"object"},"label":"Move to Component","output":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","description":"What `browser.reparent` returns.","properties":{"bodies":{"description":"The bodies that were transferred on their own.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"component":{"description":"The component they went to.","format":"uint64","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"features":{"description":"The names of the features that moved.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"occurrences":{"description":"The occurrence ids that moved.","items":{"format":"uint64","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"type":"array"},"param_warnings":{"description":"In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}},"required":["component","occurrences","features","bodies"],"title":"ReparentItemsResult","type":"object"},"params":"Moves placements, features and bodies into a component. occurrences?: [ids or paths], features?: [ids or names], bodies?: [names], component?: where they go (default: the active one), component_path?: its placement → component, occurrences, features, bodies (what moved). One undo step, all or nothing: placements move first (taking what they hold), then features (taking the bodies they made), then the bodies still elsewhere (a body transfer, which leaves its features behind)"}

{"id":"timeline.edit","input":{"$defs":{"FeatureRef":{"description":"A feature by id (a whole number) or by name.","minimum":0,"type":["integer","string"]},"SetFields":{"description":"The fields to change, merged into the feature's definition as `timeline.inspect` returns it, e.g. {\"extent\": {\"distance\": \"30\"}} for an extrude or {\"angle\": \"90 deg\"} for a revolve. A dotted key names a nested field ({\"plane.distance\": \"8 mm\"} is {\"plane\": {\"distance\": \"8 mm\"}}). Expressions are text, or a number in mm or degrees. A field the definition doesn't have is refused.","type":"object"}},"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","additionalProperties":false,"description":"Change a feature's fields: `set` is merged into the feature's definition as\n`timeline.inspect` returns it, and the design is rebuilt. The feature's type can't change. When the edited feature fails to build, the call returns\nthat build error.","properties":{"feature":{"$ref":"#/$defs/FeatureRef","description":"The feature, by id or name."},"set":{"$ref":"#/$defs/SetFields","description":"The fields to change."}},"required":["feature","set"],"title":"TimelineEditParams","type":"object"},"label":"Edit Feature","output":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","description":"What `timeline.edit` returns.","properties":{"feature":{"description":"The feature, by id.","format":"uint64","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"param_warnings":{"description":"In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"recomputed":{"description":"How many features were rebuilt.","format":"uint","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"restored":{"description":"How many features took an earlier result for the same inputs instead of being rebuilt.","format":"uint","minimum":0,"type":"integer"}},"required":["feature","recomputed","restored"],"title":"TimelineEditResult","type":"object"},"params":"feature: id|name, set: {fields to change, merged into the feature's definition as timeline.inspect returns it, e.g. {\"extent\": {\"distance\": \"30\"}} (extrude), {\"angle\": \"90 deg\"} (revolve); a dotted key names a nested field ({\"plane.distance\": \"8 mm\"} = {\"plane\": {\"distance\": \"8 mm\"}}); expressions are text, or a number in mm or degrees} → recomputed: features rebuilt, restored: features whose earlier result for the same inputs was reused"}

{"id":"component.move_features","input":{"$defs":{"IdOrName":{"description":"A feature's id (a number) or its name.","type":["number","string"]}},"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","additionalProperties":false,"description":"Move timeline features (sketches too) into a component. Their ids, names and timeline order
stay, the geometry stays where it is in the world, and the bodies they made move with them.
Nothing changes when the move would break a feature, while the timeline is rolled back, or
for a component placed more than once.","properties":{"component":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/IdOrName"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"The component they go to, by id or name. Default: the active component."},"features":{"description":"The features to move, by id or name.","items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/IdOrName"},"type":"array"}},"required":["features"],"title":"MoveFeaturesParams","type":"object"},"label":"Move Features to Component","output":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","description":"What `component.move_features` returns.","properties":{"bodies":{"description":"The bodies that moved with them.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"component":{"description":"The component they went to.","format":"uint64","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"moved":{"description":"The names of the features that moved.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"param_warnings":{"description":"In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}},"required":["moved","component","bodies"],"title":"MoveFeaturesResult","type":"object"},"params":"features: [ids or names] (sketches too); component?: where they go (default: the active one) → moved, component, bodies. Ids, names and timeline order stay; the geometry stays where it is in the world; the bodies the features made move with them.
